name: Cleaner Core for Claude
hostedCleanerCoreUrlNote: The one Cleaner Core service every host and chat uses. Saad adds each host on its /admin page and sends them an invite code.

repository.note: Claude never clones or runs Cleaner Core. The skill and the connector's own instructions carry the guide.

deployment.note: The one multi-tenant Cleaner Core service every chat shares. The full variable list is in docs/deployment.md. Each host's chat, number, and keys come from its tenant, never from these variables.

integrations.name: Cleaner Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the Cleaner Core service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the Cleaner Core page and clicks Allow. Claude cannot approve itself.
integrations.where: claude.ai Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. One connector serves every Claude app and the scheduled task. Never add it a second way.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Claude's Google Calendar connector. Claude reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

secretsGoTo: Cleaner Core's private page behind each one-time upload link. Never chat, never a tool argument.
neverIncluded: the scheduled task's Fire URL or token
Cleaner Core connector or OAuth tokens
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
host, cleaner, or contact phone numbers
live booking, cleaning, message, or photo records
